properties.name: Pueblo Police Department / Real-Time Crime Center
properties.description: Public Safety Complex hosting RTCC with ShotSpotter (6 sq mi), drones, Daktronics video wall, Community Connect intake. Operating 10am-midnight, expanding to 24/7.

properties.name: Downtown Flock ALPR Installations
properties.description: Pueblo Downtown Association-funded Flock Safety cameras covering Union Ave / Riverwalk corridors. 30-day cloud retention. Part of 1,091-camera Colorado network.
properties.notes: EFF Nov 2025 report documents Flock network used to surveil protesters nationwide.
